items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: My sister and her boyfriend were friends with a young white couple named Bob and Phyl Connors who invited us to their home.

ctx.x: My brother Ulysse was married with a nice widow who had six children. Her name was Zola. My sister Thelma had separated from her husband and was living with my father. Lily and I also stayed with Dad and Lily started

calling him Dad, which he enjoyed very much. We were in Cincy from the 16th of April until the 23rd of May and were invited to parties at least four times a week by friends of my family and some of my old musician friends that included Clarence Paige, his wife Ellen, William Smythe, who was William Smythe who was William Smith or just plain Smittie when we worked together in the old days. My sister and her boyfriend were friends with a young white couple named Bob and Phyl Connors who invited us to their home.…

We were having a swell time and I never once touched my horn because this was the first time I had taken a vacation that I was not forced to take because I didn't have any work. But the time came when we were obliged to get back to New York and spend a few more days there before going back to France. We arrived back in the Apple, the 24th of May and as our sailing date was the 3rd of June, that gave us 10 days to spend with our friends and see my buddies again.
